discussion.body: Correction. Previous build study https://i.imgur.com/PZ8WU5U.jpeg is too muscled for Acts 0-4 and does not match the Act 0 harvest-road phase art. That URL cannot be overwritten (anonymous imgur has no replace). New current Act 0-4 study: lean farm-labor build, same Padon face as wyvf5Pi / OTKB0kL phase plates, not the late Gate-coat bulk. Local file replaced: artifacts/Concept art/FEAT-027-cael-ward-build-study.jpg. PZ8WU5U is superseded, do not use for sprite scale. Late-game muscle can wait for an Act 5+ study if wanted.
